missions.title: The house by the canal
missions.button: There's a house for sale by the canal

a.text: A narrow house by the canal, two rooms and a roof to sleep on in summer. The widow selling it wants 300 coins and a buyer who will look after her husband's fig tree.

b.text: The qadi writes the sale in his book with two witnesses. The key is heavy and cold. The fig tree is yours to water.

no.text: The widow nods. “It will still be here.”

a.text: You water the fig tree, lock the door and sleep in your own house.

missions.title: An orchard
missions.button: An apricot orchard is for sale · 150 coins

a.text: A small orchard by the stream, twenty trees. Sumayya says she'll look after it with her pickers - paid on time, she adds, looking at you.
Sumayya's pickers have brought in your apricots and been paid. After the buyer, 25 coins are yours. The poor of the town are waiting at the orchard wall for the gleanings.
